Hi Bill

Have you tested composing and sending yourself a new email with attachment to see if it gets delivered.

What is giving you the indication that the email failed to send? Are you seeing an error message reporting this?

When you send an email, it's first moved into the outbox before delivery. Upon success, it should then be moved to your sent items folder.

Can you check if any emails have become stuck in the outbox. They should only exist there for a short period. After being delivered they are normally moved to the sent folder.

If your trying to forward or reply to an existing email containing an attachment, have you clicked the "download complete message" button first, before pressing forward or reply?
